query:
SELECT u.id,
                   COALESCE(
                       (SELECT wm.display_name FROM workspace_members wm
                         WHERE wm.workspace_id = $1 AND wm.user_id = u.id),
                       u.display_name, split_part(u.email, '@', 1)
                   ) AS "name!"
              FROM users u
             WHERE u.id = ANY($2)
